ana (security): we received an EU dsar: user id 9a4c requests full erasure. partner workspace export noted in our records. need immediate actions: RBAC freeze, audit export, KMS snapshot inventory, partner deletion attestation.

tom (infra): can you paste the export metadata? bucket + object + service account

ana (security): export path s3://partner-exports/eu/2025-03-01/embeds-9a4c.jsonl, run by svc-acct `sa-exporter@prod`. KMS: arn:aws:kms:eu-west-1:123456:key/abcd-emb-exports (customer-managed)

compliance-bot: retention-exception created: RE-2025-00341 (status: pending)

rui (eng-sre): applying deny on `sa-exporter` now to stop reads. capturing current ACLs and access logs. ETA ~4m.

compliance-bot: iam-update: `sa-exporter` permissions removed from partner-export-bucket (change id c9f2)

deena (legal): partner attestation required. request signed deletion statement, UTC timestamp, and sha256 checksum. if no response in 7 days escalate to contracts and DPO.

tom (infra): pausing key rotations for abcd-emb-exports and suspending auto-purge jobs. also recommend revoking any long-lived creds found in logs if leak impacted them.

ana (security): note for vuln triage: a logging agent could have captured presigned urls in plaintext between 2025-01 and 2025-02. treat as potential exposure. starting forensic snapshot.

rui (eng-sre): pulled access logs: `GET /embeds-9a4c.jsonl 200` from 35.196.12.8 by `sa-exporter` on 2025-03-01. uploaded full audit to s3://redwood-evidence/dsar/3019876543/ encrypted with evidence-kms.

ana (security): product question: do we tell the user deletion is complete now or wait for partner attestation and evidence scrub?

deena (legal): wait for partner attestation or proof of deletion on our side. set user expectation to 30 days and loop in DPO if partner pushes back.

compliance-bot: evidence-log: attachment added to RE-2025-00341

ana (security): action items: 1) infra: lock RBAC + pause key rotations 2) eng-sre: export full audit, run search for other exports for user 9a4c 3) legal: send attestation request and prepare escalation 4) product: update DSAR status message 5) security: coordinate vuln triage and label incident dsar+exposure

tom (infra): running search: SQL -> SELECT path FROM exports WHERE metadata->>'user_id'='9a4c' OR path LIKE '%9a4c%'; will post results.

compliance-bot: key-rotation canceled for abcd-emb-exports for 7 days (ticket RE-2025-00341)

rui (eng-sre): search returned no other matches. only the partner export object. attaching results to the retention ticket.

ana (security): if partner provides attestation but we still have an encrypted snapshot under our control, legal must advise on key destruction. do not destroy keys until legal confirms; forensic hold possible.

deena (legal): confirmed. preserve keys until we have partner evidence or a legal decision. starting partner email now requesting deletion proof and chain-of-custody details.

tom (infra): noted. once legal clears, we'll schedule key destruction workflow if requested.

ana (security): thanks all. add any further logs or evidence to RE-2025-00341 and keep updates in this thread. :thumbsup:
